models.name: shopping_mall_system_settings
models.description: Platform-wide configuration key/value store. Stores namespaced settings used by administrative and operational flows (feature flags, thresholds, toggles). Added explicit value format metadata to make structured settings (JSON) and schema versioning explicit for safe evolution and validation.

plainFields.name: namespace
plainFields.description: Logical namespace for the setting (e.g., "shopping", "payments", "notifications").

plainFields.name: key
plainFields.description: Setting key within the namespace (unique per namespace).

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Serialized setting value (string). For structured content the `value_is_json` flag indicates JSON payload.

plainFields.name: value_is_json
plainFields.description: Indicates whether `value` contains JSON serialized text (true) or plain string (false). Allows safe parsing by consumers during migration to Json column.

plainFields.name: value_schema
plainFields.description: Optional schema identifier or version for structured JSON config (e.g., "featureFlag:v1"). Useful for validation and migration tooling.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Human-friendly description and operational guidance for the setting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_currencies
models.description: Currency reference table. Contains ISO currency code, display name, symbol, decimal precision and active flag. Serves as authoritative currency metadata for pricing, formatting, and settlement flows.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., "USD", "KRW"). Unique business key.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable currency name (e.g., "US Dollar").

plainFields.name: symbol
plainFields.description: Display symbol for the currency (e.g., "$", "₩").

plainFields.name: decimal_digits
plainFields.description: Number of decimal digits used for the currency (e.g., 2 for USD, 0 for JPY).

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this currency is currently enabled for use on the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_countries
models.description: Country and region metadata used by shipping, tax, and localization subsystems. Added nullable FK to shopping_mall_currencies to avoid drift between string codes and canonical currency records while preserving `default_currency_code` for compatibility.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_currency_id
foreignFields.description: Optional canonical currency reference for the country. {@link shopping_mall_currencies.id}. Nullable for countries without assigned currency in platform configuration.

plainFields.name: iso_code
plainFields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., "KR", "US"). Unique key.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Country display name.

plainFields.name: region
plainFields.description: Geographic region grouping (e.g., "Asia", "Europe").

plainFields.name: calling_code
plainFields.description: International dialing code (E.164 prefix, e.g., "+82").

plainFields.name: default_currency_code
plainFields.description: Optional ISO currency code commonly used in the country. Retained for backward compatibility; prefer shopping_mall_currency_id when present.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_profiles
models.description: Shipping profile definitions that describe carrier rules, base pricing, and optional free-shipping thresholds. Added explicit currency FK and store monetary amounts in minor units (int) to avoid floating point rounding and multi-currency ambiguity.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_currency_id
foreignFields.description: Currency used for profile amounts. {@link shopping_mall_currencies.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique machine-friendly code for the shipping profile (e.g., "standard_domestic").

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-friendly shipping profile name.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Operational notes describing the profile behavior and carrier mapping.

plainFields.name: base_price
plainFields.description: Base shipping price in minor currency units (e.g., cents) to avoid floating-point rounding issues.

plainFields.name: free_threshold
plainFields.description: Order subtotal threshold in minor currency units above which shipping is free for this profile; null if not applicable.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether the shipping profile is currently available for selection.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_tax_profiles
models.description: Tax profile definitions used to compute taxes during checkout. Each tax profile is associated with a country (shopping_mall_countries) and defines a percentage rate and whether the tax is inclusive. Profiles are versionable by creating new records (historical snapshots handled by separate components if needed).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_country_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced country's {@\link shopping_mall_countries.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Tax profile name (e.g., "VAT 10% - Domestic").

plainFields.name: rate
plainFields.description: Tax rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.0 for 10%).

plainFields.name: is_inclusive
plainFields.description: Whether tax is price-inclusive (true) or added on top of price (false).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Operational notes and jurisdictional guidance for the tax profile.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Customer accounts: authentication credentials, basic profile, and lifecycle timestamps. Customers are platform shoppers who own carts, orders, wishlists, and reviews. This table stores PII and authentication data; password hashes only, never plain passwords. Related entities: {@link shopping_mall_carts}, {@link shopping_mall_orders}, {@link shopping_mall_wishlists}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's verified email address used for login and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the customer's password (bcrypt/argon2). Never store plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Full name or display name of the customer.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Phone number in E.164 format when provided by the customer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Session records for customers. Stores per-session connection context for auditing and session management. Fields are strictly limited to the session table pattern: actor FK, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the session origin.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or origin href associated with the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the session.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Seller accounts representing marketplace merchants. Stores authentication, basic storefront metadata, verification flag, and lifecycle timestamps. Sellers manage products, SKUs, inventory, and orders for their catalog. Related entities: {@link shopping_mall_products}, {@link shopping_mall_payouts}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller account email used for login and notifications.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the seller's password.

plainFields.name: store_name
plainFields.description: Public name of the seller's store.

plainFields.name: store_description
plainFields.description: Optional seller-provided store description.

plainFields.name: is_verified
plainFields.description: Indicator whether seller onboarding verification is complete.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for seller accounts.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Session records for sellers. Conforms exactly to the Session Table Pattern: includes actor FK, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at. Used for seller session auditing and per-device session management.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged seller's {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address for the seller session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or origin for the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the session.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description: Platform administrators and their authentication profile. Admins manage moderation, refunds, and platform settings. High-privilege roles require audit trails and can be flagged as super_admin for emergency overrides.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin login email address.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the admin's password.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Admin full name for audit and display.

plainFields.name: is_super
plainFields.description: Flag identifying super_admins who can perform emergency overrides.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for admin accounts.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: Session records for admin accounts. Conforms to the required session table field set for auditing admin sessions and ensuring per-device session revocation.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged admin's {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the admin session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL associated with the admin session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the admin session.

models.name: shopping_mall_support_agents
models.description: Support agent accounts (business-operator) used for customer-support workflows and limited impersonation operations. Actions by support agents must be auditable. Support agents have distinct accounts separate from admins and sellers.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Support agent email used for login and audit identification.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hash of the support agent's password.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Agent display name for audit records.

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Optional contact phone number for the agent.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for support agent accounts.

models.name: shopping_mall_support_sessions
models.description: Session table for support agents. Records per-device/session connection metadata for auditing impersonation and support actions. Adheres to the exact session table pattern for the Actors component.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_support_agent_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged support agent's {@link shopping_mall_support_agents.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Session origin IP address.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL or originating href.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Optional expiry timestamp for the session.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Product container representing a seller-owned catalog item. Removed derived aggregate fields (average_rating, review_count) to avoid storing calculated metrics in the primary business table. Aggregate metrics are provided by a materialized view (mv_shopping_mall_product_ratings). Product remains the canonical product metadata store and links to seller and snapshots.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: Owning seller reference. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Human-readable product title used in listings and search.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: Unique URL-friendly product slug.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Long-form product description for detail pages.

plainFields.name: default_image_uri
plainFields.description: Canonical product image URI used as thumbnail.

plainFields.name: is_published

plainFields.name: updated_at

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Product-level media assets. Each image references a product and provides ordering and accessibility metadata.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: uri
plainFields.description: Image resource URI.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text for accessibility.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Display order; lower values shown first.

plainFields.description: Creation time.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: shopping_mall_categories
models.description: Hierarchical product taxonomy used for navigation and faceted search. Parent relationship supports nested categories.

foreignFields.description: Parent category reference. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}. Nullable for root categories.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Category display name.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description: Junction table linking products and categories (many-to-many). Ensures unique associations per product/category pair.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product reference. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_category_id
foreignFields.description: Category reference. {@link shopping_mall_categories.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Association creation time.

models.name: shopping_mall_variants
models.description: SKU (variant) entities representing sellable units with independent price and inventory. Added explicit inventory counters (available/reserved/committed) as canonical low-latency fields. The transactional inventory log (shopping_mall_inventory_transactions) and reservation table remain the audit and reservation sources; these counters are the fast-access snapshot used by storefront and availability checks.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Parent product reference. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: sku
plainFields.description: Platform-unique SKU code.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Variant display title (e.g., 'Red / L').

plainFields.name: price
plainFields.description: Current price for this variant.

plainFields.name: available
plainFields.description: Units currently available for sale (not reserved/committed). This is the canonical availability counter used by storefront queries.

plainFields.name: reserved
plainFields.description: Quantity currently reserved (checkout holds) for this variant. Reservation lifecycle maintained in shopping_mall_inventory_reservations; this counter is a snapshot to speed availability checks.

plainFields.name: committed
plainFields.description: Quantity permanently committed to paid orders (not yet shipped). Used for settlement and reconciliation calculations.

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Optional weight for shipping calculations.

plainFields.name: is_backorder
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether backorders are allowed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_options
models.description: Normalized key/value option records for variant attributes (color, size, material). Prevents repeating groups and supports flexible attribute sets.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced variant. {@link shopping_mall_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Option name (e.g., 'color').

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Option value (e.g., 'red').

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_variant_images
models.description: Variant-specific image resources for SKUs that require dedicated imagery (color swatches, texture).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_variant_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced variant. {@link shopping_mall_variants.id}.

plainFields.name: uri
plainFields.description: Image resource URI.

plainFields.name: alt_text
plainFields.description: Alternative text.

plainFields.name: position
plainFields.description: Display order position.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_snapshots
models.description: Append-only snapshots of product state for audit, historical price/attribute queries, and rollbacks. Each snapshot records product fields at snapshot time.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Product title at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: Product slug at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Product description at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: default_image_uri
plainFields.description: Product default image URI at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: average_rating
plainFields.description: Average rating at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: review_count
plainFields.description: Review count at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: is_published
plainFields.description: Published flag at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_at
plainFields.description: When this snapshot was taken.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation time.

models.name: mv_shopping_mall_product_ratings
models.description: Materialized view (read-only) storing denormalized product rating aggregates for fast reads. This mv replaces storing average_rating and review_count on the product table and must be refreshed on a schedule or updated incrementally by triggers/background jobs. Marked material: true and stance: "subsidiary".

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced product {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: average_rating
plainFields.description: Computed average rating for the product (derived from reviews). Stored here in the materialized view for fast reads.

plainFields.name: review_count
plainFields.description: Count of published reviews for the product at aggregation time.

plainFields.name: last_updated_at
plainFields.description: When this materialized row was last refreshed.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp for this mv row (can mirror last_updated_at).

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Persistent shopping carts. Represents a customer's active or saved cart or a guest session cart. Links optionally to a {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} for authenticated users or to {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id} for guest/cart-session scenarios. Used to support cart merging, device sync, and checkout preparation. Contains soft-delete and temporal fields for audit and retention.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Owning customer's {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Nullable to allow guest carts tied to a session.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_session_id
foreignFields.description: Guest session reference {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}. Nullable when cart is owned by an authenticated customer.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Optional human-friendly name for a saved cart (e.g., 'Holiday gifts').

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Flag indicating whether the cart is active (not archived).

plainFields.name: reservation_expires_at
plainFields.description: Optional reservation expiry timestamp when cart holds reservations (seller opt-in scenarios).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp.

models.description: Line items contained in a shopping cart. plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Unit price captured when the item was added to cart for price consistency checks. Changed to double precision to align with SKU price representation (shopping_mall_variants.price).

plainFields.name: note
plainFields.description: Optional buyer note for this cart line (stored for UX, not for business logic).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Item added timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification timestamp for this cart item.

plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for item removal history.

models.name: shopping_mall_articles
models.description: Primary article entity storing published and draft content authored by platform administrators. Used for CMS content, editorial workflows, and public article listing. Related to {\@link shopping_mall_article_snapshots} (historical snapshots) and {\@link shopping_mall_article_comments} (user comments).

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring admin's {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Article title used for listings and search.

plainFields.name: slug
plainFields.description: URL-friendly unique slug for the article.

plainFields.name: excerpt
plainFields.description: Short summary or teaser shown in lists and share cards.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full article body. Stored as text for rendering and snapshotting.

plainFields.name: cover_image_uri
plainFields.description: URI to the article's cover image.

plainFields.name: is_published
plainFields.description: Whether the article is published and visible to end users.

plainFields.name: published_at

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last modification timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp; null when active.

models.name: shopping_mall_article_comments
models.description: User comments on articles. Comments belong to an article and are authored by customers. Comments are independently manageable for moderation, search, and user activity queries. Related to {\@link shopping_mall_articles} and {\@link shopping_mall_customers}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_article_id
foreignFields.description: Parent article's {@link shopping_mall_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Comment author's customer id {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Comment body text.

plainFields.name: is_visible
plainFields.description: Visibility flag for moderation (true = visible).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Comment creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Comment last modification timestamp (edits).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for moderation removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_article_snapshots
models.description: Append-only snapshot records capturing point-in-time state of articles for audit, moderation history, and rollback. Each snapshot preserves article fields and snapshot metadata. Added explicit snapshot_at and optional author reference for improved auditability and uniqueness.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_article_id
foreignFields.description: Referenced article. {@link shopping_mall_articles.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Optional authoring admin who created the snapshot. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}. Nullable for system-generated snapshots.

plainFields.name: snapshot_title
plainFields.description: Article title captured in this snapshot.

plainFields.name: snapshot_slug
plainFields.description: Article slug captured in this snapshot.

plainFields.name: snapshot_excerpt
plainFields.description: Snapshot of article excerpt.

plainFields.name: snapshot_body
plainFields.description: Full article body at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_cover_image_uri
plainFields.description: Cover image URI as captured in snapshot.

plainFields.name: snapshot_is_published
plainFields.description: Published state at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_published_at
plainFields.description: Published timestamp at snapshot time.

plainFields.name: snapshot_at
